title: Factorizing random sets and type III Arveson systems
summary: We develop a representative-level framework for the Liebscher-Tsirelson random-set construction of Arveson systems from stationary factorizing measure types. We introduce the notion of a measurable factorizing family of probability measures on hyperspaces of closed subsets of time intervals and prove that every such family canonically generates an Arveson system. Within this framework we obtain a purely measure-theoretic characterization of spatiality: positive normalized units correspond exactly to dominated families of measures that factorize strictly.
